name: @inneranimalmedia/agentsam-3d-viewer
purpose: Shared framework-agnostic Three.js viewer for GLB, GLTF, and STL assets across public pages and AgentSam workspaces.
use_when: Showing an existing GLB, GLTF, or STL in a public marketing page or application panel
Creating a reusable Three.js viewport while keeping CAD-specific selection and scene logic in the host
avoid_when: Generating precision solids or Boolean geometry; use agentsam-occt
Replacing specialized BIM, robotics, or scene-authoring behavior with a generic asset viewer
